product_one_liner.value: DataGrail is an agentic data-privacy platform that automates data mapping, data-subject requests, consent, assessments, discovery and risk management for privacy, legal and security teams at brands.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage's navigation/footer does not expose a public pricing page; purchasing is presented through contact/sales-led packaging.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is a marketing/product and industry-updates blog; it does not show at least two qualifying engineer-authored build/architecture posts.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple product areas and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles listed are in customer success, marketing and security/IT; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy says AI-enabled features use AI services available through AWS.

compliance_certs.notes: That page explicitly says DataGrail is HIPAA compliant and has SOC 2 Type II certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The cited announcement dates the latest identified round to October 2022, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists open roles but none is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 6, 2026 post reports 20+ updates shipped in September 2026, including new Vera, assessment, consent, request-manager and integration capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Amy Reagan Hollo's profile records her move from VP of Operations to COO in April 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy explicitly identifies Gong for sales-team engagement, Outreach for sales automation/analytics, and HubSpot for marketing outreach/automation.
